scope: Best-effort local corpus of publicly accessible Ramanujan scans/facsimiles and published-paper PDFs, plus initial mining notes.
limitations: The four notebooks are saved as PDF facsimiles and extracted page images from ramanujan.sirinudi.org; they are not guaranteed to be the highest-resolution color archival originals.
Trinity College lists digitized originals for Add.MS a/94.1-18 and Add.MS a/396; this run inventoried those URLs but did not bulk-download every Wren/UV high-resolution page image.

Notebook pages are image-only; no OCR/HTR transcription was attempted, because mathematical handwriting OCR would be high-risk. Mining notes are therefore source/theme-level plus page-image inventory, not a full symbolic extraction of every formula.
